svg.title: Example: Buffering & Swarming
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape board: unplanned work history, buffer sizing and rules, swarm triggers, a five-step swarm routine, a swarm log, and an iteration check.
svg.text: Protect capacity for the unexpected, and agree when the team stops starting and gathers to finish.
Manage Flow · Capacity Buffer · Swarm Triggers · Stop Starting, Start Finishing
